summary: Shopify removes the marketCurrencySettingsUpdate mutation in API version 2027-01
details:
As of Admin API version 2027-01, the marketCurrencySettingsUpdate mutation and its payload and error types are removed. Every call already returns the UNIFIED_MARKETS_ENABLED user error; on 2027-01 the request is rejected at validation.

Set market currency settings through marketCreate and marketUpdate, which accept them directly, and remove calls to marketCurrencySettingsUpdate before moving to 2027-01.
